{{Eastern name order|Berényi Dénes}}
'''Dénes Berényi''' (26 December 1928 – June 27, 2012)<ref>{{cite web |author=Hozzászólok |url=http://www.haon.hu/elhunyt-berenyi-denes-atomfizikus-az-mta-rendes-tagja/2018046 |title=Elhunyt Berényi Dénes atomfizikus, az MTA rendes tagja &#124; HAON |publisher=Haon.hu |date=2012-06-27 |accessdate=2012-07-05 |archive-date=2016-02-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160203131905/http://www.haon.hu/elhunyt-berenyi-denes-atomfizikus-az-mta-rendes-tagja/2018046 |url-status=dead }}</ref> was a Hungarian [[nuclear physicist]], member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] (MTA) and Head of the [[Institute of Nuclear Research of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] from 1976 to 1990. The [[5694 Berényi]] is named after him.
